1	//! Output store adapter: bytes in a private file, index in `tool_outputs`.
2	use crate::error::StoreError;
3	use agentkit_core::{OutputError, OutputHandle, OutputInfo, OutputMeta};
4	use std::path::PathBuf;
5	use std::sync::Arc;
6	
7	const MAX_STORED: u64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
8	
9	pub struct SqliteOutputStore {
10	    root: PathBuf,
11	    store: Arc<SqliteStore>,
12	}
13	
14	impl SqliteOutputStore {
15	    /// Write the bytes then insert the row.
16	    pub async fn put(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
17	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
18	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
19	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
20	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
21	        }
22	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
23	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
24	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
25	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "put");
26	        Ok(())
27	    }
28	
29	    /// Read the index row of a handle.
30	    pub async fn info(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
31	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
32	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
33	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
34	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
35	        }
36	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
37	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
38	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
39	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "info");
40	        Ok(())
41	    }
42	
43	    /// Slice a stored output by lines or bytes.
44	    pub async fn read(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
45	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
46	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
47	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
48	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
49	        }
50	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
51	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
52	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
53	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "read");
54	        Ok(())
55	    }
56	
57	    /// Match a pattern against stored lines.
58	    pub async fn search(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
59	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
60	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
61	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
62	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
63	        }
64	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
65	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
66	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
67	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "search");
68	        Ok(())
69	    }
70	
71	    /// Remove every output of a session.
72	    pub async fn purge_session(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
73	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
74	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
75	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
76	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
77	        }
78	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
79	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
80	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
81	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "purge_session");
82	        Ok(())
83	    }
84	
85	    /// Remove expired rows and orphan files.
86	    pub async fn sweep(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
87	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
88	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
89	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
90	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
91	        }
92	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
93	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
94	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
95	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "sweep");
96	        Ok(())
97	    }
98	
99	    /// Check length and digest of a stored file.
100	    pub async fn verify(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
101	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
102	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
103	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
104	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
105	        }
106	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
107	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
108	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
109	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "verify");
110	        Ok(())
111	    }
112	
113	    /// Move the expiry of a session forward.
114	    pub async fn touch(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
115	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
116	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
117	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
118	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
119	        }
120	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
121	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
122	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
123	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "touch");
124	        Ok(())
125	    }
126	
127	    /// Report size and line count.
128	    pub async fn stat(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
129	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
130	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
131	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
132	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
133	        }
134	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
135	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
136	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
137	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "stat");
138	        Ok(())
139	    }
140	
141	    /// Tell whether a handle is known.
142	    pub async fn exists(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
143	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
144	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
145	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
146	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
147	        }
148	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
149	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
150	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
151	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "exists");
152	        Ok(())
153	    }
154	
155	    /// Move a session directory aside.
156	    pub async fn rename_aside(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
157	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
158	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
159	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
160	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
161	        }
162	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
163	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
164	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
165	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "rename_aside");
166	        Ok(())
167	    }
168	
169	    /// Move a session directory back.
170	    pub async fn restore(&self, session: &str, handle: &OutputHandle) -> Result<(), OutputError> {
171	        let path = self.path_of(session, handle)?;
172	        let guard = self.store.lock().await;
173	        if !path.starts_with(&self.root) {
174	            return Err(OutputError::InvalidHandle(handle.to_string()));
175	        }
176	        let row = guard.query_row("SELECT byte_len FROM tool_outputs WHERE handle = ?1", [handle.as_str()], |r| r.get::<_, u64>(0))
177	            .map_err(|e| OutputError::Storage(e.to_string()))?;
178	        if row > MAX_STORED { return Err(OutputError::Integrity(handle.to_string())); }
179	        tracing::debug!(%handle, bytes = row, "restore");
180	        Ok(())
181	    }
182	
183	}
184	
185	#[cfg(test)]
186	mod tests {
187	    use super::*;
188	
189	    #[tokio::test]
190	    async fn put_then_read_round_trips() {
191	        let store = open_temp().await;
192	        let handle = store.put("s1", b"a\nb\n").await.unwrap();
193	        assert_eq!(store.read(&handle, 1, 10).await.unwrap().total_lines, 2);
194	    }
195	}
